title: Reconstructing diagrams from PDFs by vision model - and the limits we kept
focus: Make the opinionated case for why the PDF vision path is remote-provider-only, capped at 10 pages, and deliberately unhelpful on pure-scan PDFs - arguing that each limit encodes a real tradeoff (context budget, local-llama text-only, empty-result short-circuit) the user should understand before relying on it.
